Delhi Court to Hear Plea on Delayed FIR Copy for Ex-Bureaucrat

A Delhi court is scheduled to hear a plea filed by retired bureaucrat Ashish Joshi, who is seeking a copy of a First Information Report (FIR) from the Delhi Police Special Cell. Joshi was reportedly questioned for nine hours over his social media posts. The plea raises questions about procedural safeguards, Article 21 rights, and transparency. The Delhi Police provided Joshi with a copy of the FIR on the eve of the court hearing.
